# istio Provider

Terraform provider for Istio (CRDs and multi-cluster). Connects to Kubernetes where Istio is installed. CRD manifest attributes redact sensitive fields to "(redacted)" in state after read while non-sensitive fields remain visible in plan output. Set validate_on_plan to run server-side dry-run validation during terraform plan.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Configure the Istio provider using the default kubeconfig.
provider "istio" {}

# Using a specific kubeconfig path and context.
provider "istio" {
  config_path    = "~/.kube/config"
  config_context = "my-cluster"
}

# Using explicit credentials (e.g. for CI/CD).
provider "istio" {
  host                   = "https://my-cluster.example.com:443"
  token                  = var.kube_token
  cluster_ca_certificate = var.kube_ca_cert
}

# Using in-cluster config (when running inside a Kubernetes pod).
provider "istio" {
  in_cluster = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cluster_ca_certificate` (String) Base64 cluster CA certificate.
- `config_context` (String) Context name from kubeconfig.
- `config_path` (String) Path to kubeconfig. Defaults to KUBECONFIG or ~/.kube/config.
- `host` (String) API server host (when not using kubeconfig).
- `in_cluster` (Boolean) Use in-cluster config (when running inside a pod).
- `insecure` (Boolean) Skip TLS verification.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Bearer token for API server.
- `validate_on_plan` (Boolean) When true, runs server-side dry-run create/update against the cluster during terraform plan to validate manifests. Requires a reachable API server at plan time.
